    Injective resolutions of the interval representations in K(Q₀) #

    Each interval l has a resolution I⁰(l) → I¹(l) by objects of Q₀: Y → 0, P i → 0, and P i → Y for A i (Step 1 of the proof of Proposition 2.3). The resolution complex is the two-term complex double; its image under ι₀ is a bounded complex of injective representations, hence K-injective.
